answer: Stop sybils with a tide anchor: each agent anchors one identity to a tide cycle with a bond renewed by that cycle’s work. Each tide it emits a live-work plume; verifiers void an anchor with a stale, copied, or missing plume, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 bonds and plumes at 18x honest cost each: each plume fits one anchor and one tide, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents anchor once and keep rights.
